item.simplestoragemanager.infinity_upgra: Allows you to access connected inventories at any distance in the same dimension.
item.simplestoragemanager.dimensional_in: Allows you to access connected inventories at any distance in up to five selected dimensions.
item.simplestoragemanager.multidimension: Allows you to access connected inventories at any distance in any dimension you are in.
message.simplestoragemanager.no_inventor: This block has no accessible inventory.
message.simplestoragemanager.multiblock_: Could not establish the connection. The multiblock structure exceeds the 5x5x5 limit.
message.simplestoragemanager.terminal_no: Only the terminal owner can modify connected inventories.
Only the terminal owner can connect or disconnect inventories.
message.simplestoragemanager.inventory_a: This inventory is already connected to another terminal.
screen.simplestoragemanager.chunk_unload: Chunk for inventory at %s is not loaded.
screen.simplestoragemanager.dimension_mi: The inventory at %s is not in this dimension
screen.simplestoragemanager.unavailable_: This can happen if the inventory was removed or its chunk is not loaded. In basic mode, it can also be out of range or in another dimension.
screen.simplestoragemanager.inventory_lo: Enabling this lock makes deposited items return to their origin inventory first.
Disabling this lock makes the terminal work the default way.
screen.simplestoragemanager.no_inventori: Shift + right-click a block that have an inventory to connect it.
screen.simplestoragemanager.replacement_: The connection with the inventory at (%s, %s, %s) was lost. A new inventory was detected there.
screen.simplestoragemanager.dimension_se: You can only select up to five dimensions.
